implementation: Completed on localhost; private release prepared. Live publication awaits authenticated Chrome Plesk session.

requirements.requirement: Role-dependent navigation and consistent merchant layout
Users, roles, scopes, account state, search, details and export (section 3.16)
Server-side RBAC, tenant isolation and validation
MFA for sensitive changes, secure recovery and bounded sessions
Real account state, loading, empty/error feedback and unsaved-form protection

implemented: Owner-controlled invitations, role editing, suspension, restoration, membership revocation and session revocation.
Single-use hashed invitation tokens, 72-hour expiry, trusted-origin fragment links and work-email verification.
Dedicated work-account acceptance with versioned terms/privacy acknowledgment; existing personal or privileged identities cannot be converted.
NUERS-branded encrypted email outbox, stale invitation validation, resend/cancel and standard password-recovery links; owner cannot choose or read staff passwords.
Global platform roles and registered business owners are protected from merchant-controlled password resets or session revocation.
Nine allowlisted capabilities and seven editable presets; grants never derive from role display names.
Branch / terminal document reads, detail lookups, PDF and CSV access enforce tenant, exact branch and source-terminal scope.
Terminal provenance is recorded only for a unique active API key/terminal/branch association; missing historical provenance is excluded from narrow scopes.
Delegated invoice/customer mutations recheck token and permissions after acquiring the merchant lock.
Joined user metadata avoids directory N+1 queries; bounded directory of 1,000 work records and up to 25 roles.
Formula-safe, owner-authorized directory export; real statistics and timezone-qualified timestamps.
intentional_limits: Team grants are controlled by the registered business owner. Merchant Admin does not grant platform administration or ownership.
Branch/terminal-scoped roles currently support document reads/exports only. Creation, customers, reports, wallet and integration metadata require business-wide scope; unsupported routes fail closed.
API credential mutation, wallet funding/settings, fee changes, taxpayer authority and BIR submission approvals are not delegated by these roles.
Existing personal or privileged NUERS accounts require a separate work email for invitation.
This feature does not certify BIR accreditation, issuance authority, official connectivity or production acknowledgment.

browser: Reference-size desktop in Chrome; mobile 390px has no document overflow.
